experiment_config.scope: training/latency defaults applied; physical resource model is evaluated separately

optimizer: SGD with momentum and weight decay
momentum_policy: reset local momentum after each model aggregation/broadcast
bn_aggregation: sample-weighted floating BN buffers; integer counters use maximum
round_definition: 1 SL round = 1 complete shuffled local epoch, drop_last=False
split_semantics: independent UAV prefix and per-UAV server suffix; full-model weighted aggregation
test_selection: maximum validation accuracy; minimum validation loss on ties; test selected model(s) once after all training
